title: Fantasy Clockwork Vortex
description: A large skeletal dragon wearing a purple hooded cloak flies through a swirling vortex of time and magic with its mouth open and orange tongue out. Below it a green and blue flying elephant with wings holds a purple orb while a witch on a broomstick flies nearby and a green beetle carries a large clock as multiple hot air balloons shaped like clocks float in the background.
prompt: A large skeletal dragon in a purple hooded cloak flies with its mouth open through a swirling colorful vortex of time and magic. A green and blue winged elephant holds a purple orb nearby while a witch with long white hair rides a broomstick below. A green beetle carries a large clock and many hot air balloon clocks float in the background against a vibrant swirling sky with a bright sun at the top.
